notes: v6.5.1 - Hotfix: Song Finder downloads now always land. If the saving tool finishes without clearly saying where it put the song, Nalox Aura now finds the file in the downloads folder and uses it - and Diagnostics records exactly what happened, so a failed download is never a mystery again. Everything from v6.5 is included: one-click Nalox Connect, the in-panel Tutorial video, Song Finder previews with a Stop button, and Image Search. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
